notes: Bounded coverage of every Earth terrain candidate in the Copernicus GLO-90 manifest; this is not a global or exhaustive survey.
NASA POWER daily values are coarse reanalysis/model context on an approximately 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid, not local 1.98 km measurements.
Every observation is context_only and must never enter Terrain similarity scoring.
Failures are recorded per point and per source; missing values are never zero-filled.
